Definitions shared by more than one servtuner schema.

Schema file: `schema/json/common.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `ea52778da279`.

## Definitions

### duration

A Go-style duration string such as "500ms", "120s" or "1m30s". The one duration representation used in every schema.

Type: `string` (pattern `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ns\|us\|ms\|s\|m\|h))+$`)

### transportMode

How one connection is secured. Never inferred.

Type: `"mtls"`, `"platform"`, `"tls"`

### utcTimestamp

An RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC: a Z suffix, optional fractional seconds. The one timestamp representation used in every schema. Enforced by the pattern alone, with no format keyword, so every language checks it the same way.

Type: `string` (pattern `^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]\|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]\|[12][0-9]\|3[01])T([01][0-9]\|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:([0-5][0-9]\|60)(\.[0-9]+)?Z$`)

### scrapeIntervalSource

Where a scrape interval came from: read from Prometheus (/api/v1/targets) or assumed because Prometheus could not be asked.

Type: `"discovered"`, `"assumed"`

### bootstrapInterval

A non-negative statistic with its bootstrap confidence interval, in the unit of the property that holds it. Either value, ci\_low and ci\_high are all present, or they are all absent and insufficient\_samples\_reason says why (too few samples for the percentile); never both. ci\_low &lt;= value &lt;= ci\_high is not expressible here and is a servtuner analyze self-check.

| Field                         | Type      | Required | Description                                                                 |
| ----------------------------- | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`                       | `number`  | No       | ≥ 0                                                                         |
| `ci_low`                      | `number`  | No       | ≥ 0                                                                         |
| `ci_high`                     | `number`  | No       | ≥ 0                                                                         |
| `samples`                     | `integer` | Yes      | Observations the statistic was computed from. ≥ 0                           |
| `insufficient_samples_reason` | `string`  | No       | Present when value and the bounds are omitted because samples is too small. |

Exactly which fields are allowed together is restricted further by the schema.

### metricName

A lowercase series name: letters, digits and underscores. Used for RunSpec extra queries and bundle series files.

Type: `string` (pattern `^[a-z0-9_]+$`)

### catalogName

A Prometheus query catalog; extra is the RunSpec's extra\_queries.

Type: `"kubernetes"`, `"bifrost"`, `"vllm"`, `"litellm"`, `"dcgm"`, `"extra"`

### sloName

The SLO keys of the RunSpec's slos block.

Type: `"ttft_p95"`, `"e2e_p95"`, `"itl_p95"`, `"max_error_rate"`
